cards.ex: The police are determined to bring the perpetrators to justice.
cards.exUz: Politsiya aybdorlarni javobgarlikka tortishga qat'iy qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatchini sudga topshirib, qonun oldida javob berishiga erishmoq.

cards.ex: He was held in contempt of court for refusing to answer the judge's questions.
cards.exUz: U sudya savollariga javob berishdan bosh tortgani uchun sudni hurmatsizlashda ayblanib hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Sud qaroriga yoki sud xodimlariga hurmatsizlik ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves a fair trial, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson, kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, odilona sudga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Qonun asosida, adolatli va xolis sud jarayoni.

cards.ex: In a criminal trial, the burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
cards.exUz: Jinoiy sudda isbotlash majburiyati prokuratura zimmasida.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlikni isbotlash vazifasi, odatda prokuror zimmasida.

cards.ex: The judge ruled the testimony inadmissible as it was based on hearsay evidence.
cards.exUz: Sudya guvohlikni qabul qilib bo'lmaydi deb qaror qildi, chunki u g'iybat daliliga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Birovdan eshitilgan, lekin shaxsan ko'rilmagan dalil.

cards.ex: The appeals court decided to uphold the conviction.
cards.exUz: Apellyatsiya sudi hukmni tasdiqlashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sud hukmini yuqori sud tomonidan o'zgarishsiz qoldirish.

cards.ex: He is currently serving a ten-year sentence for fraud.
cards.exUz: Hozirda u firibgarlik uchun o'n yillik jazoni o'tamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sud tomonidan tayinlangan qamoq jazosini o'tamoq.

cards.ex: The judge took the extenuating circumstances into consideration when sentencing the defendant.
cards.exUz: Sudya ayblanuvchiga hukm chiqarishda yengillashtiruvchi holatlarni hisobga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatni sodir etishga sabab bo'lgan, javobgarlikni kamaytiradigan holatlar.

cards.ex: Organizations are working to overturn wrongful convictions.
cards.exUz: Tashkilotlar noto'g'ri hukmlarni bekor qilish uchun ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Aybsiz odamga chiqarilgan noto'g'ri sud hukmi.

cards.ex: The key witness is expected to take the stand tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Asosiy guvoh ertaga guvohlik berishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sudda guvoh sifatida o'z ko'rsatmalarini bermoq.

cards.ex: The evidence proved his guilt beyond all doubt.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uning aybdorligini shubhasiz isbotladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha qoldirmaydigan darajada aniq.

cards.ex: The judge declared a mistrial after the jury failed to reach a unanimous verdict.
cards.exUz: Hakamlar hay'ati bir ovozdan qarorga kelmaganidan so'ng, sudya sudni bekor qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayoni xato tufayli bekor qilindi, yangidan boshlanishi kerak.

cards.ex: He was charged with obstructing justice by destroying evidence.
cards.exUz: U dalillarni yo'q qilish orqali adolatga to'sqinlik qilishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayoniga xalaqit beradigan harakatlar qilmoq.

cards.ex: The defendant plans to appeal the decision.
cards.exUz: Ayblanuvchi qarorni shikoyat qilmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Sud qaroriga norozilik bildirib, yuqori sudga murojaat qilmoq.

cards.ex: This case could set a legal precedent for future disputes.
cards.exUz: Bu ish kelajakdagi bahslar uchun huquqiy pretsedent yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda qabul qilingan qaror, kelajakdagi ishlarga namuna bo'ladi.

cards.ex: He claimed he signed the confession under duress.
cards.exUz: U tan olishni majburiyat ostida imzolaganini da'vo qildi.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik, tahdid yoki bosim ostida biror narsa qilmoq.

cards.ex: The rule of law is essential for a just society.
cards.exUz: Qonun ustuvorligi adolatli jamiyat uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Hammaning qonun oldida tengligi, qonun barchaga barobar ta'sir qilishi.

cards.ex: He was charged with aggravated assault after attacking someone with a knife.
cards.exUz: U pichoq bilan birovga hujum qilganidan so'ng og'irlashtirilgan hujumda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy jarohat yetkazish yoki qurol ishlatish bilan sodir etilgan hujum.

cards.ex: She accepted a plea bargain to avoid a lengthy trial.
cards.exUz: U uzoq sud jarayonidan qochish uchun kelishuv bitimini qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ayblanuvchi aybini tan oladi, lekin yengilroq jazo olish uchun.

cards.ex: The eye-witness account was crucial to the investigation.
cards.exUz: Guvohning hikoyasi tergov uchun juda muhim edi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani o'z ko'zi bilan ko'rgan odamning hikoyasi.

cards.ex: The prosecution had to prove criminal intent.
cards.exUz: Prokuratura jinoiy niyatni isbotlashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatni sodir etishga qaratilgan niyat yoki maqsad.

cards.ex: The suspect was taken into custody after a brief chase.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi qisqa ta'qibdan so'ng qamoqqa olindi.
cards.uzDef: Rasman hibsga olib, politsiya nazoratiga topshirmoq.

cards.ex: The lawyer filed a motion to quash the subpoena.
cards.exUz: Advokat chaqiruvni bekor qilish to'g'risida ariza topshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudning chaqiruv qog'ozini bekor qilish to'g'risida qaror chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiations were conducted in good faith.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar halol niyat bilan olib borildi.
cards.uzDef: Halol, vijdonan va adolatli bo'lish, g'arazsiz niyat bilan.

cards.ex: He was charged with perjury after lying under oath.
cards.exUz: U qasamyod ostida yolg'on gapirganidan so'ng yolg'on guvohlik berishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Sudda qasamyod qilib, yolg'on ko'rsatma bermoq.

cards.ex: The statute of limitations has expired in this case.
cards.exUz: Bu ishda da'vo muddati tugagan.
cards.uzDef: Da'vo qo'zg'atish uchun belgilangan vaqt, muddat o'tgach da'vo qabul qilinmaydi.

cards.ex: The court granted a stay of execution.
cards.exUz: Sud jazoni ijro etishni to'xtatish to'g'risida qaror qabul qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jazoni ijro etishni vaqtincha to'xtatish, odatda apellyatsiya ko'rib chiqilayotganda.

cards.ex: The defense argued there were mitigating circumstances.
cards.exUz: Himoyachi yengillashtiruvchi omillar borligini ta'kidladi.
cards.uzDef: Jazoni yengillashtirishga sabab bo'luvchi omillar.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to due process of law.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson qonuniy tartibga rioya qilinishiga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy huquqlarni ta'minlash, adolatli sud jarayonini o'tkazish.

cards.ex: If there's reasonable doubt, the jury must acquit.
cards.exUz: Agar asosli shubha bo'lsa, hakamlar hay'ati oqlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorlikka ishonch hosil qilishga to'sqinlik qiladigan shubha.
